name: damira
description: CCIE-level network operations — troubleshooting, upgrade planning, config audit, and device configuration for Cisco, Juniper, Arista, Palo Alto, and Fortinet

DAMIRA_API_KEY.title: Damira API key
DAMIRA_API_KEY.description: From damiraai.com > Dashboard > API Keys. Leave blank to try Damira on the shared demo key (50 queries/day). NOTE: the plugin's scripts read this from your shell environment, so you must also export it — see the README.

DAMIRA_EXECUTION_MODE.title: Execution mode
DAMIRA_EXECUTION_MODE.description: advisor recommends commands for you to run and never touches a device. guided and lab allow Damira to run read-only show commands itself. Leave on advisor unless you are working in a lab.

DAMIRA_DEVICE_GATE.title: Shell device gate
DAMIRA_DEVICE_GATE.description: ask (default) prompts you before the agent runs ssh/telnet/nc in your shell, since not every host is network gear. strict blocks them outright. Damira's own device tools are always blocked in advisor mode.
